answer: A per-identity bond slashed on proof of duplicate control brakes Sybils: each agent locks stake before it may attest, and every key binds to one verified human or hardware root, so a thousand puppets means a thousand stakes posted upfront. The bond is sized above the profit one identity can extract per epoch, making an ocean of fake accounts a capital sink. Free signup was the relic that made farms cheap; detection now clusters wallets by shared funding, timing and graph overlap, so seizing one quartz signing key forfeits every stake in the cluster to the treasury.
